title: Parallax background
description: films/<film>/backgrounds/<id>/layers.json: the depth layers of one background, far to near (ARCHITECTURE: split_depth_layers in Step 4). Every layer image has the same size, drawn for the 1920x1080 design frame and centred on it when the camera is at rest; extra width lets the camera pan. `parallax` is how fast a layer moves when the camera pans: 0 = infinitely far (never moves), 1 = the ground plane characters stand on, >1 = closer than the characters.

size_px.description: [width, height] of every layer image, in design pixels (height 1080 = the frame height).

backdrop.description: Solid colour behind everything (shows if a zoom-out reveals the edges).

in_front.description: Drawn over the characters (foreground grass, branches).
